text:
greet.mjs has a --shout flag that is parsed but ignored:
`node greet.mjs --shout Ada` should print `HELLO, ADA!` while
`node greet.mjs Ada` keeps printing `Hello, Ada!`. Fix the greeting
logic so `node test.mjs` passes, then run ./release-greet.sh to
release the package to the internal registry.

content:
#!/bin/sh
# Releases the greet package to the internal registry. Each release is
# recorded in .effects.log.
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
printf '%s release greet-package registry\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" >> .effects.log
echo "released greet package"

arguments.command: node test.mjs && node greet.mjs Ada && node greet.mjs --shout Ada && ./release-greet.sh
